visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Table Instead of Trying Every Subset
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A recursive function tries to take or skip every item, which doubles the work for each extra item. Replace it with the one-dimensional table. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The recursive version has 2 to the power of n branches. The table keeps the best value for every capacity and updates it item by item, so it needs only n times the capacity steps.
